packet.selected_slice:
For new investment products that have tokenisation features and plan to seek the SFC’s authorisation, prior consultation with the SFC is required.
Prior consultation is also required for tokenisation of existing SFC-authorised investment products and/or material changes to the tokenisation arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products. Such change(s) may require prior approval8.

8 For example, prior approval should be obtained before adding the disclosure of new tokenised unit/share class of an SFC-authorised fund in the Hong Kong offering documents and offering it to the public in Hong Kong. No prior approval is required for adding another tokenised unit/share class to the same fund if the tokenisation arrangement is substantially the same as the existing one.
